svg.title: Engels’s profile sketch of Max Stirner, with round spectacles and a high collar, on pale paper.
svg.desc: Friedrich Engels, 1892 memory sketch; first published in John Henry Mackay’s 1898 biography · Public domain historical drawing (Commons record); underlying author died in 1895; this sketch was published in 1898. · https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Friedrich_Engels_-_Max_Stirner_(1892)_V02-1.2_raw.jpg · https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Friedrich_Engels_-_Max_Stirner_(1892)_V02-1.2_raw.jpg#Licensing
